   - **deleteRecipe**: Delete by recipeID (set recipeID to 0), error 16#8004 if not found
   - **modifyRecipe**: Replace existing recipe, error 16#8005 if not found

   - recipeQueryResult (ST_Recipe)
   - error (BOOL)
